title: Swasth-AI — Health Management Platform
description: An AI-integrated health platform built on the MERN stack with secure JWT authentication and Gemini API-powered health features.

title: Career Bridge — Job & Internship Portal
description: A secure REST API built with Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, featuring JWT authentication, RBAC, job/internship management, resume uploads, applications, and Swagger documentation.

title: NetSage AI — Cisco Network Troubleshooting Assistant
description: An AI-powered network troubleshooting assistant that analyzes network symptoms, topology, and Cisco CLI outputs to identify root causes, OSI layers, evidence, and recommended troubleshooting steps — with mandatory human review before accepting a fix.

title: E-Commerce Website
description: A full-stack e-commerce web app with product listings, cart functionality, and MongoDB-backed CRUD APIs for inventory management.
